description: Land Acquisition - Vannarpannai South-East, Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District - Akurala, Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific lands to be acquired by the government for public purposes (sewerage pumping station construction), provides detailed land descriptions including plot numbers, locations, extents, and owners, and outlines the legal process for compensation claims. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition and property matters.
